items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So we were good friends. He stayed downstairs there. We were good friends and I went to introduce him to… I had Reverend Johnson my minister over at the church.

ctx.x: It‟s absolutely good for you for sure. That‟s wonderful, thank you.

There‟s one more I‟d like to tell you about this Reverend Johnson before you. Benny [Unintelligible]. You know what a [unintelligible] guy Ben was but underneath he had a very soft heart. He was a pussycat but if he was drinking or something he had [unintelligible] and they was all upset. But he loved me, and he loved Mona, and he loved my daughter Charlotte so much. The last place he lived in the United States was at this house. When he left here he never came back, but he left right from here. My address is in…
